description: This file is a shell script that defines functions and tests for checking git attributes such as check-attr, check-attr with source, object mode, macro expansion, and attribute compatibility. It includes setup routines and test cases for various scenarios involving git attributes and gitattributes files.

methods.name: attr_check_basic
methods.description: Checks the basic git attribute for a given file path with expected value and git options.

methods.name: attr_check
methods.description: Performs attribute check and verifies error output is empty.

methods.name: attr_check_object_mode_basic
methods.description: Checks the object mode attribute for a file path with expected value.

methods.name: attr_check_object_mode
methods.description: Performs object mode attribute check with verification.

methods.name: attr_check_quote
methods.description: Checks attribute with a quoted path and expected value.

methods.name: attr_check_source
methods.description: Checks attribute with a specific source and verifies multiple ways of specifying the source.
